articles.title: Dan Hicks, NBC’s voice of golf and Olympic swimming, dies at age of 64 after acute illness
articles.summary: Death announced by wife, ESPN’s Hannah Storm. Hicks had a 35-year career in broadcasting. Sportscaster Dan Hicks, who was the voice of golf, Olympic swimming and Notre Dame football during a 35-year career at NBC Sports, has died, his family and NBC announced Thursday. He was 64.
body: Hicks died late Wednesday in Connecticut. He died of an acute illness, according to his wife, ESPN broadcaster Hannah Storm.

“Our family is heartbroken by the sudden and unexpected passing of Dan,” Storm said in a statement. “He was a devoted husband of over 30 years, loving father to our three daughters, and cherished friend to so many. His loss is immeasurable.

“Dan was truly one of a kind and, quite simply, the person everyone wanted to be around. When he walked into a room, he brought the energy, the laughter and the people together. He was endlessly kind, thoughtful and funny, and he made everyone feel like they mattered.”
Hicks was best known as the lead announcer for golf, as well as swimming and skiing at the Olympics and Notre Dame football. He joined NBC in 1992 following three years at CNN.

articles.title: SFA in talks with Boston officials over biannual friendly match
articles.summary: Discussions take place between Scottish football governing's body and a delegation of state senators to build on bonds forged during the World Cup.
body: BBC Scotland has learned that the SFA is in active discussions aimed at a biannual friendly match being held in Boston.

Scotland played two World Cup matches in the US city during the summer and now the governing body and the state of Massachusetts are in talks aimed at building the bonds made between locals and the Tartan Army, through football.
More discussions are due to take place between the SFA and a delegation of state senators ahead of Scotland's Nations League match against North Macedonia at Hampden on Friday.
It has not yet been decided who will play in the game but BBC Scotland understands it will involve the Scoland national team.

articles.title: Harry Kane wins record 126th England cap, pulling clear of Peter Shilton
articles.summary: Kane gets England men’s record cap against Croatia. Striker starts Nations League game on record 91 goals. Harry Kane has broken the England men’s appearance record after being selected to start the Nations League match against Croatia at Wembley.
body: Kane, who made his debut in March 2015, took his international goals tally to 91 by scoring six times in four games in late September and early October. England’s next-highest scorer, Wayne Rooney, is a distant second with 53 goals.

The caps record comes two and a half weeks after Kane won the Ballon d’Or, reward for a 2025-26 season during which he scored 61 goals in 51 appearances for Bayern Munich and helped England to a World Cup semi-final.
Seven women have made more England appearances than Kane, with the list topped by Fara Williams, who played 172 times.

Kane said on Wednesday that he hoped to set records that will stand for years. The 33-year-old is conscious that two of his England teammates have won a significant number of caps. Declan Rice has 80 at the age of 27; Jude Bellingham 60 at 23. “I’ll try to give them a good number to catch,” Kane said. “The goal record, of course, is going to be one that’s difficult to beat for a while.”

articles.title: Ghana kick-start Afcon 2027 bid despite Ayew penalty miss
articles.summary: Jordan Ayew has a first-half penalty saved as Ghana secure a comfortable 2-0 home win over Somalia to kick-start their Afcon 2027 qualifying campaign.
body: Ghana belatedly kick-started their 2027 Africa Cup of Nations (Afcon) qualifying campaign with a 2-0 home win over Somalia.

Ghana women's coach Kim Bjorkegren was placed in interim charge for this month's double-header against the Ocean Stars, with the West Africans in danger of missing a second successive edition of the Afcon finals.

The hosts were given a chance to take an early lead in Sekondi-Takoradi after Alidu Seidu was pulled down in the box, but Jordan Ayew's 14th-minute penalty was saved by Somalia goalkeeper Ibrahim Hussein.
Ghana did go ahead in first-half stoppage time when Mohammed Salisu headed Mohammed Kudus's deep corner back across goal and Jonas Adjetey nodded in from six yards out.

articles.title: Plans to increase Windsor Park capacity to 23,750 part of Women's World Cup bid
articles.summary: The planned redevelopment of Windsor Park to enable the stadium to host games at the 2035 Women's World Cup includes proposals to increase the capacity of the stadium to 23,750, according to a Fifa report.
body: A joint bid to host the tournament has been submitted by the governing bodies in England, Northern Ireland, Scotland and Wales.
The UK-wide bid is the only one put forward to host the tournament and is therefore set to be ratified at the Extraordinary Fifa Congress on 23 November.

Belfast's Windsor Park is the only stadium from Northern Ireland nominated as part of the bid, but in order to comply with the Fifa proposal that it could host games up until the quarter-final stage, the capacity of the venue must be increased from the current 18,500 capacity.
The Fifa report said that "further redevelopment is planned, including the increase in capacity" of Windsor Park up to 23,750 by 2035.

From how the format works to the promotion and relegation rules, here's everything you need to know about the UEFA Nations League.

articles.title: Lawes recovering after hospital stay with infection
articles.summary: Courtney Lawes says he spent 10 days in hospital after doctors found his infection markers were "through the roof" as he battled a serious illness.
body: The 37-year-old said a staph infection, external was the reason for his absence from rugby, having not played since Sale Sharks' Champions Cup defeat by Glasgow Warriors on 17 October.
Speaking on The Good, The Bad & The Rugby Xtra podcast,, external Lawes said he initially believed he was suffering from flu.
"I had flu symptoms but some really bad muscle pains with it. On the way home, my right arm basically stopped working, so really weird symptoms," Lawes said.
A staph infection is caused by staphylococcus bacteria, which can live harmlessly on the skin but become serious if they enter the bloodstream through a wound or break in the skin.

articles.title: The trilingual son of Mr Universe makes homecoming - NFL Gameday Guide
articles.summary: Amon-Ra St. Brown. The globe-trotting trilingual son of Mr Universe, named after an Egyptian god, returning for the most special of homecomings to his mother's native land. This time, as one of the stars of the NFL.
body: Some five years ago, St. Brown spoke to Sky Sports about the importance of his German heritage ahead of entering the NFL Draft. And now he gets to honour it by doing what he does best.
The Detroit Lions will play an international game for the first time since November 2015 this Sunday when they host the New England Patriots at Munich's Allianz Arena.

His mother Miriam hails from Leverkusen and predominantly spoke to the Lions wide receiver and his two brothers in German growing up, while also taking them back to Europe each summer to spend time with their grandparents and play soccer.

St Brown even represented the German national team alongside brother Osiris during his sophomore year of high school, and since landing in the NFL, has worn decals of the German flag on his helmet and returned to host football camps in the country.

articles.title: Lazio Opt Against Keeping Midfielder With Expiring Contract
articles.summary: Lazio have reportedly decided to part ways with Danilo Cataldi when his contract expires at the end of the season. The Background. The experienced midfielder has only made one cameo appearance this term, as he spent the first two months of the season recovering from groin surgery.
body: Lazio’s early-season accomplishments see them climb to the top of the table alone for the first time since the 2010/11 campaign. Needless to say, none of the current squad players was part of the senior squad at the time, but Cataldi would probably recall that period, given how he was developing his game in the club’s youth sector.

The midfielder became a member of the first team in 2013, but was sent out on loan to Crotone that season, before rejoining Lazio’s senior squad the following year. Afterwards, the Roman’s career has been a rollercoaster. He was considered a key player at times, only to become an exile on other occasions.

Between January 2017 and June 2018, Catldi had back-to-back loan spells at Genoa and Benevento. In the summer of 2024, he fell out with the management after being passed over for the captaincy in favour of Mattia Zaccagni. The midfielder had a positive campaign at Fiorentina, but the Tuscans opted against exercising their option to buy him.
Cataldi thus returned to Lazio once again in the summer of 2025, coinciding with Maurizio Sarri’s comeback. He ended up reclaiming his starting role amid Nicolo Rovella’s injury nightmare.

Neville believes Carrick deserved greater respect from a club he represented with distinction as a player.

articles.title: 15 international players who could become the NBA’s next global superstars
articles.summary: Throughout NBA history, American players have dominated the league. And while there has been an influx of international players in the past, basketball has become a global sport since then. As a result, more and more stars from around the world have started to make their mark.
body: 15 international players who could become the NBA’s next global superstars appeared first on ClutchPoints. Add ClutchPoints as a Preferred Source by clicking here.

With Arvydas Sabonis first opening the door for overseas players, the likes of Dirk Nowitzki, Yao Ming, and Pau Gasol soon followed. However, the impact of international players has further grown since then. Today, they make up some of the best players in the league, including the likes of Nikola Jokic, Giannis Antetokounmpo, and Luka Doncic.

In fact, the rapid rise of Shai Gilgeous-Alexander and Victor Wembanyama as the league’s top stars is the best manifestation of the international wave. But with these names ruling the league now, it’s worth wondering who’s next.
Let’s take a look at 15 international players who could become the NBA’s next global superstars.
